content:
I have created the UI Framework and all requested screen and component scripts for the Mini Kingdom Unity project.

Files created:
- UI/Core/UIManager.cs
- UI/Core/ScreenBase.cs
- UI/Core/PopupManager.cs
- UI/Core/UIAnimations.cs
- UI/Screens/KingdomScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/DungeonSelectScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/DungeonHUDScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/LevelUpScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/RunResultScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/RoyalDecreeScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/DiscoveryBookScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/BuildingDetailScreen.cs
- UI/Screens/SettingsScreen.cs
- UI/Components/ResourceBar.cs
- UI/Components/SkillButton.cs
- UI/Components/FloatingText.cs

They include proper namespaces, references to required systems (simulated/ready for integration), and DOTween-like coroutine fallbacks for animations. Let me know if you need anything else!
